title: PINK MALL Product Creative Contract
description: Structure of contract 02. Closed vocabularies are genuinely closed; required membership is proved by allOf/contains with minContains and maxContains, never by uniqueItems alone.

consent.description: Current consent state is deliberately absent. additionalProperties:false is what keeps a cached copy out, so resolving consent at its authority can never leave this contract stale.

executionLayer.description: Durable authority semantics only. Facts about a particular authoring session — whether a provider was called, whether credits were spent — describe an operation, not policy, and belong in that phase's report rather than in a normative contract.

qaSemantics.description: Applicability and result are separate dimensions. NOT_APPLICABLE is a marker, never a fourth result.
